user.title: BRUH Bambu Studio
user.description: Connect Home Assistant to the BRUH Bambu Studio add-on. The add-on must be installed and running — it is what talks to your printers.

hassio_confirm.title: BRUH Bambu Studio
hassio_confirm.description: Set up BRUH Bambu Studio so Home Assistant gets print services and a sensor set for each Bambu Lab printer?

abort.already_configured: BRUH Bambu Studio is already set up.

get_status.name: Get status
get_status.description: Every printer's state, progress, temperatures and AMS, whether Bambu Studio is installed and running, and the latest jobs. Changes nothing.

list_files.name: List files
list_files.description: The models and sliced print files in /share/bambu, with which are sliced, their plates, print time and weight.

printer_files.name: List the printer's files
printer_files.description: What is on a printer's own storage.

printer.name: Printer
printer.description: Which printer, by its name or serial number. Left out when there is only one.

print_file.name: Print a file
print_file.description: Print a file from /share/bambu. A project that is not sliced yet is sliced first with the settings saved in it; a bare model (an STL, a STEP, a 3MF from Printables) with Bambu Studio's own profiles for the printer and the filament in the tray. Then it is uploaded to the printer and started.

file.name: File
file.description: Its path inside /share/bambu, as list_files shows it.

printer.name: Printer
printer.description: Which printer, by its name or serial number. Left out when there is only one.

plate.name: Plate
plate.description: Which plate of the project to print. Left out, the first.

use_ams.name: Use the AMS
use_ams.description: Feed filament from the AMS. Left out, it is used when the printer has one.

ams_mapping.name: AMS slots
ams_mapping.description: Which AMS slot (0-based) feeds each filament in the file, in order. Left out, filament 1 from slot 1 and so on.

machine.name: Machine profile
machine.description: Only for a bare model that has to be sliced: the printer profile name as Bambu Studio lists it, or one of your printers by its name (its model decides the profile).

process.name: Process profile
process.description: Only for a bare model: the process profile name.

filaments.name: Filament profiles
filaments.description: Only for a bare model: filament profile names, one per filament.

slot.name: Filament tray
slot.description: For a bare model (an STL, or a 3MF from Printables): the AMS tray to print from, 0 for the first, or "external" for the external spool. Left out, the tray that best matches the material and colour.

material.name: Material
material.description: For a bare model on the external spool, or to pick the AMS tray: PLA, PETG, ABS… Left out, PLA.

colour.name: Colour
colour.description: For a bare model with no tray named: the colour to look for in the AMS.

plate_type.name: Build plate
plate_type.description: The plate on the printer: auto, textured_pei, smooth_pei, cool or engineering. The slice and the printer's plate check follow it.

speed.name: Speed
speed.description: The speed profile to switch to once it starts.

layer_inspect.name: First-layer inspection
layer_inspect.description: X1: let the lidar check the first layer.

copies.name: Copies
copies.description: How many of it, arranged on the plate. The file is sliced again for this.

settings.name: Slicer settings
settings.description: For a model that is sliced here: options such as layer_height, walls, infill_percent, supports, brim, print_sequence (by layer or by object), ironing, seam. The panel's Print dialog lists them all.

slice_file.name: Slice a file
slice_file.description: Slice a project or model from /share/bambu with Bambu Studio and save the print file in /share/bambu/sliced.

machine.name: Machine profile
machine.description: The printer profile name as Bambu Studio lists it, or one of your printers by its name (its model decides the profile).

arrange.name: Arrange
arrange.description: Arrange the objects on the plate first.

orient.name: Orient
orient.description: Turn each object to its best orientation first.

printer.name: Printer
printer.description: Which printer, by its name or serial number. Left out when there is only one.

printer.name: Printer
printer.description: Which printer, by its name or serial number. Left out when there is only one.

stop_print.name: Stop
stop_print.description: Stop the current print. A stopped print cannot be resumed.

printer.name: Printer
printer.description: Which printer, by its name or serial number. Left out when there is only one.

printer.name: Printer
printer.description: Which printer, by its name or serial number. Left out when there is only one.

set_light.name: Chamber light
set_light.description: Turn the chamber light on or off.

printer.name: Printer
printer.description: Which printer, by its name or serial number. Left out when there is only one.

set_temperature.name: Set temperature
set_temperature.description: Set the nozzle or bed target. Refused while printing.

printer.name: Printer
printer.description: Which printer, by its name or serial number. Left out when there is only one.

temperature.name: Temperature
temperature.description: °C. Nozzle up to 300, bed up to 120; 0 turns it off.

send_gcode.name: Send G-code
send_gcode.description: Send G-code lines to the printer. Refused while printing; at most 32 lines.

printer.name: Printer
printer.description: Which printer, by its name or serial number. Left out when there is only one.

open_in_studio.name: Open in Bambu Studio
open_in_studio.description: Open a file from /share/bambu in the Bambu Studio panel.

import_url.name: Import from a link
import_url.description: Bring a model into /share/bambu/imports from a Printables model page (every model file on it) or from a link to an .stl, .3mf, .step, .obj or .amf file. MakerWorld needs a signed-in Bambu account, so it is refused with where to open it instead. Answers with the imported files' paths, ready for print_file.

url.name: Link
url.description: The Printables page or the file's own link.

find_printers.name: Find printers
find_printers.description: Look for Bambu Lab printers on the network Home Assistant is on, by the certificate each one's MQTT port answers with. Answers with each printer's address, serial number and model, and whether it is added already. Changes nothing.

subnet.name: Network
subnet.description: The network to search instead, such as 192.168.2.0/24.

reconnect.name: Reconnect
reconnect.description: Drop the add-on's connection to the printer and open a new one, as after the printer was switched off and on.

printer.name: Printer
printer.description: Which printer, by its name or serial number. Left out when there is only one.

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.description: Ask the printer for a full report now: its state, temperatures and every AMS tray (after a spool was changed).

printer.name: Printer
printer.description: Which printer, by its name or serial number. Left out when there is only one.

design_part.name: Design a part with brAIn
design_part.description: Describe a part and brAIn designs it, builds it and keeps it as a version on the Design tab; or name a part and say what to change. Answers as soon as brAIn has started, with the part's id and name; designing takes minutes, so ask design_status afterwards. Needs brAIn with its Automation integration on.

description.name: Description
description.description: What the part is, with any sizes that matter.

name.name: Name
name.description: What to call a new part. Left out, brAIn names it.

part.name: Part
part.description: A part already designed, by its id or its name, to change instead of starting a new one.

message.name: Message
message.description: What to change about that part.

design_status.name: Design status
design_status.description: How a designed part is doing — its latest version, whether brAIn is still working on it, brAIn's last reply, whether it built, and any print of it — or every part when none is named. Changes nothing.

part.name: Part
part.description: The part, by its id or its name. Left out, every part.

print_part.name: Print a designed part
print_part.description: Slice a designed part with Bambu Studio's own profiles for the printer and the filament in the tray, and send it — the Design tab's Slice and print. Answers once it has started; design_status says how the print is going.

part.name: Part
part.description: The part, by its id or its name.

version.name: Version
version.description: Which version to print. Left out, the current one.

printer.name: Printer
printer.description: Which printer, by its name or serial number. Left out when there is only one.

slot.name: AMS tray
slot.description: Which AMS tray (0-based) to print from, or external. Left out, the tray whose filament best fits the part.

copies.name: Copies
copies.description: How many of it, arranged on the plate.

settings.name: Settings
settings.description: Print settings over the part's own, as the Design tab's print options name them (layer_height, infill_density, wall_loops, supports...).

check_print.name: Check the print now
check_print.description: Have brAIn look at the print through the camera now, whatever the plan says. Needs failure detection on for the printer, the camera able to see, and brAIn.

printer.name: Printer
printer.description: Which printer, by its name or serial number. Left out when there is only one.

print_alert_action.name: Answer a print alert
print_alert_action.description: Answer what failure detection raised: ignore it for the rest of the print, pause, resume after a false alarm (the same problem then only warns), or stop. Also says the plate is clear, or that something is on it.

printer.name: Printer
printer.description: Which printer, by its name or serial number. Left out when there is only one.

action.name: Action
action.description: ignore, pause, resume, stop, plate_clear or plate_occupied.

alert.name: Alert
alert.description: The alert's id, so an answer to an old alert is refused rather than applied to a new one. Left out, the open alert.

set_failure_detection.name: Set print failure detection
set_failure_detection.description: Switch print failure detection on or off for a printer, and choose whether a failed print is paused or only warned about, how careful it is, whether it may turn the chamber light on to see, whether it watches for the plate being cleared, and which phone gets the alerts.

printer.name: Printer
printer.description: Which printer, by its name or serial number. Left out when there is only one.

mode.name: When a print fails
mode.description: pause: warn, and pause a print that has failed. warn: only warn.

sensitivity.name: Sensitivity
sensitivity.description: low looks less often and needs to be surer; high looks more and raises doubts sooner.

light.name: Turn the light on
light.description: Turn the chamber light on when it is too dark to see the print.

plate.name: Watch the plate
plate.description: After a print, watch for the plate being cleared (the Plate clear sensor).

notify.name: Notify
notify.description: The notify service alerts go to, such as notify.mobile_app_pixel; empty for Home Assistant's own notifications only. One setting for every printer.
